integrity: Exact rational Bellman recurrence, independent path-weight computation, full labelled enumeration for orders 2 through 5, and an analytic all-m formula. Scientific statements are internally checked; no independent external validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a finite connected simple undirected graph, a single uniformly sampled index case, one uniformly random neighbor contacted by each infectious vertex exactly once, certain infection of susceptible recipients, permanent recovery, and cumulative expected outbreak size. It does not classify all graphs larger than five vertices, other infectious periods, multiple contacts, nonuniform initial seeds, or empirical network effects.
title: A six-vertex threshold for epidemic slowdown under one-contact transmission
